|lore=Jon 'Dutch' Vander. Gold Squadron leader at Battle of Yavin. Prefers Y-wing fighters. Previously led squadron at Renforra Base. Emblem of Specter Squadron on his helmet.

* Printed face: [[Dutch]]
|strategy=By Royce Russell, Gold 15<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20001011182145/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/small/dutch.html</ref>

[[Dutch]] is a great mainstay for any deck. Many people have chosen not to use him anymore in favor of the more recent, higher power characters.

The best thing about [[Dutch]] is his low deploy cost of 2 and his high forfeit of 5! Say you're buiding a cheap deploy deck, [[Dutch]] is your man. He adds +1 forfeit to every other Gold Squadron pilot at the same site or system! The most powerful part of this card is his ability to draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise if he is piloting his ship [[Gold 1]].

Combos:

[[Dutch]] + [[Pops]] + [[Tiree]] - With this combo at a site you have a power of 6 with a total forfeit of 15!! All this for just 6 Force, what a deal!

[[Dutch]] + [[Gold 1]] - alone at a system he draws one destiny if not able to otherwise, if you draw a 6 you would have a power of 10, forfeit of 8, all for just 3 Force, wow!!

[[Dutch]] + [[Tiree]] + [[Gold 2]] - this little combo gives you a power 6 ship with a maneuver of 5 and forfeit of 13! Use it with your [[Death Star]] destruction deck and it adds one to your [[Attack Run]] total!
